rounding_policy.meaning: Rounding allowance only; not engineering acceptance tolerance.

psychrometric_equations.humidity_ratio_method: Approximate psychrometer relation used by the current calculator: pws = 0.61094 exp(17.625 Twb / (Twb + 243.04)); gamma = 0.00066 (1 + 0.00115 Twb); pw = pws − gamma P (Tdb − Twb); W = 0.621945 pw / (P − pw).
psychrometric_equations.air_load_method: Use outdoor-state specific volume for dry-air mass flow, h = 1.006 Tdb + W (2501 + 1.86 Tdb), Qs = ṁ × 1.006 × (Tout − Tin), and Ql = ṁ (hout − hin) − Qs.
psychrometric_equations.limitation: The wet-bulb input basis (measured psychrometer versus thermodynamic wet-bulb) must be confirmed for a real project. These fixed cases validate the stated approximate relation and arithmetic; they do not constitute method approval.

exclusions: Surface films beyond the supplied U-value

cases.equation: people × per-person gain × diversity / 1000, separately for sensible and latent
assumptions: One diversity factor applies to both components
All scheduled lighting input is treated as room sensible gain
exclusions: Power not released to the room

cases.equation: quantity × heat-to-space watts × diversity × space-gain factor / 1000
assumptions: Watts are heat rejected to this room per unit
exclusions: Electrical input not rejected to the room

cases.equation: ṁ = V̇ / vout; Qs = ṁ × 1.006 × ΔT; Qt = ṁ × (hout − hin); Ql = Qt − Qs
assumptions: Wet-bulb-derived humidity ratios at stated pressure
Volume flow is referenced to outdoor-air state
Expected values rounded to 4 decimal places

cases.equation: ṁda = V̇ × 1.2 kgda/m³; Qs = ṁda × 1.006 × ΔT; Qt = ṁda × (hout − hin); Ql = Qt − Qs
assumptions: Standard-air density is explicitly selected as 1.2 kg dry air/m³
Humidity ratios use the separately stated psychrometric conditions
Expected loads were hand-calculated from stored humidity ratios and the stated equations
exclusions: Does not establish that a project airflow schedule uses standard-air volume
Does not validate Australian ventilation requirements

cases.equation: V̇ (L/s) = ACH × room volume / 3.6; psychrometric sensible and latent loads as in outside_air_psychrometric_load
assumptions: ACH is referenced to the reviewed room volume

cases.equation: Qc = U × opening area × ΔT / 1000; Qsolar = incident solar × corrected glass area × transmission × external shade × internal shade / 1000
assumptions: All areas and factors are supplied
Conduction uses opening area while transmitted solar uses corrected glass area

cases.equation: Per-hour component gains are summed at coincident schedule hours; room safety allowance is then applied once
assumptions: The same outdoor and indoor design states apply at all 24 hours
Envelope 0.055 kW is constant; supplied schedules are binary and peak at the stated distinct hours
